classifications.rationale: The President establishes an internal advisory task force; this is executive organization rather than a change to substantive legal rights or duties.
classifications.evidence: I am establishing a Presidential Task Force on Global Resources and Environment.

classifications.rationale: The segment assigns membership, analytical and consultative responsibilities, and reporting duties to an internal presidential task force, with no dictated legal outcome.
classifications.evidence: The Task Force will report to me within six months and periodically thereafter on its progress

classifications.rationale: The President directs the task force to coordinate, prioritize attention, and assess federal efforts and analytical capacity; these are internal management and study functions.
classifications.evidence: I have directed the Task Force to work closely with you in carrying out its responsibilities

classifications.rationale: Agencies must support the task force, which must provide recommendations and progress reports; these are internal cooperation and reporting requirements without a specified legal consequence.
classifications.evidence: Each of your agencies shall cooperate with and support this important Task Force.
